notes: Saving a model on the AI key card now sticks. If your kit's model had ever been removed, saving a new one said it was saved, but your kit's jobs stayed without a model and the card read not set again after a restart. The save now gives every job the model you chose, and the card remembers it when you reopen your kit.
An update that lands while your kit is reading your history no longer reports a crash. The reading is paused, recorded as interrupted, and carries on from where it stopped when your kit starts again.
